Overview[edit]

This is the short version of the guide.

Starting out

[edit | edit source]
  • In Taverley, talk to Ivy Sophista in the house west of the summoning obelisk. (1•✓)
  • Go upstairs, talk to Thaerisk Cemphier and kill both assassins.[1]
  • Talk to Radimus Erkle (fairy ring BLR).

Finding Movario's base

Items needed: Any logs, ring of charos (a) or 5,000 coins, mort myre fungus
Recommended: Watchtower Teleport, Ardougne Teleport (Ardougne cloak is best)

Feldip Hunter area

  • Talk to the Hunting expert in the Feldip Hunter area about tracking a person.
  • Trap the square trap pit to the west, then use the mort myre fungus on it.

Khazard

Location of the Khazard launderer

Dismiss any followers before the next steps.

  • With the ring of charos (a) equipped, talk to the Khazard launderer. (2•2) If you brought coins instead: (1)
  • Cast NPC Contact to talk to:
    • Turael
    • Duradel (1)
    • Mazchna
  • Go to the laundry room west of the Fight Arena. Show on map

CAUTION: items dropped in this room are lost.

Intended method

"Prohibited" is the key word. Match the odd symbol to a rune.

Symbol to rune
SymbolRune
OMind rune
HEarth rune
Note
  • Search the old battered door and use the right rune on it.
  • Go through the old battered door.

Catching Lucien's spy

  1. Go to the Black Knights' Fortress and talk to the guard.
  2. Follow the spy to the bar.
